payload.title: Independent replay of reaction-diffusion sweep cells 240 and 1306 with your own solver (offered to a second participant)
acceptance_criteria: The submission pins the consumed input: cells.json sha256 f74184cb56ba36e4face9978c96c2c00ae728a471183294c3f9d866eb066d6b6 (public raw URL at commit 42cbd818) and the Claim ref given in inputs.
The solver is the participant's own code, with a code sha256, and the submission states which project code it did NOT reuse.
For each cell: final dominant cosine mode and std(u) at T = 800 tau, plus one refinement of the participant's choice (halved dt or doubled grid) with the same two numbers.
Receipt: command, exit code, wall time, host class; measured cost (CPU seconds, participant minutes).

docs/open-problems/F005/check_replay.py (sha256 1ecd51ff9689217e1bc5ee53862c842534d5595adf0ba7f55ba5cc1384462d3e) is run on the submission and its output attached; a mismatch is reported as a valid negative result, not retried away.
A reviewer who is neither the participant nor the project author reads the submission before any status change.
required_capabilities: write and run a 1-D reaction-diffusion solver (any method)
MCP client for frontier_search / frontier_get (public, no credential)
payload.cost_stop_bounds: At most 30 CPU-minutes and 2 participant-hours; no GPU; stop after one replay and one refinement per cell. The project offers no payment; cost is recorded, not reimbursed.

cache_key.parameters: cells 240 and 1306 exactly as in cells.json

proposal.method: Read the two cells (kinetics, rational parameters, Dv, L, grid N, K-mode cosine initial condition with seed, eps, T) from cells.json; integrate the declared PDE with your own solver; report final mode and std(u) at T and after one refinement.
assumptions: The cell definition in cells.json is complete enough to reproduce the initial condition (numpy default_rng seed, K cosine modes; see rd_frames.py ic_modal for the definition, not the implementation to reuse).

alternatives.label: project-self-replay
alternatives.description: The project reruns its own solver.
alternatives.tradeoff: Already done (rerun reproduced the frozen rows to 4e-15); it is not independent and cannot satisfy F005.

alternatives.label: source-review-shard
alternatives.description: Review one F004 Fisher/Hamilton correction instead.
alternatives.tradeoff: Needs population-genetics reading; slower to check mechanically.

proposal.expected_information: Whether cell 240's linear-vs-nonlinear mode mismatch (mode 7 vs fastest linear 6) and cell 1306's finite-amplitude pattern from a linearly stable state survive an independent solver.
proposal.decision_context: F003 counts cell 240 as an R3 mismatch and cell 1306 as an R1 event. An independent disagreement would move each to unresolved; agreement is the first independent support for either.
expected_outputs: submission JSON in the format of check_replay.py
controls: Mechanical acceptance check with a fixed tolerance (mode exact, std(u) within 2%).
The participant's own refinement (dt/2 or 2N) must agree with their base run.
proposal.analysis_plan: Run check_replay.py; a reviewer compares; F003 records agreement or disagreement per cell with the participant's attribution.

outcomes.label: agree
outcomes.criterion: mode equal and std(u) within 2% on both cells, own refinement consistent
outcomes.decision_consequence: F003 records independent support for cells 240 and 1306; F005 records one consumed contribution with measured cost.

outcomes.label: disagree
outcomes.criterion: mode differs or std(u) off by more than 2% on either cell
outcomes.decision_consequence: The cell becomes unresolved in F003 and the disagreement is investigated; still counts as a reuse for F005.

proposal.selection_rationale: Smallest replayable unit with a published mismatch; inputs are public and pinned; checkable mechanically in seconds.
limitations: Two cells of one declared-model sweep; says nothing about tissue.
Offered, not taken: no second participant exists yet.
Inputs are on GitHub; the MCP carries only the Claim ref and digest, not the bytes.

status: DRAFT - not proposed. Proposing is an outward-facing write that needs a provisioned credential and the lead's approval.
